objective: Predict absolute barrier error with endpoint-only features; energy, force and TS-force remain reported outcomes, not guaranteed improvements.
fallback: Every policy uses the same legacy model outside the frozen geometry radius. A specialist system cannot borrow the newly trained global model.
comparison: Fixed endpoint gate, fold-selected fixed expert, two grouped OOF risk estimators and unattainable barrier oracle; compare all systems against single_general fixed gate and retain all member/region metrics.
scope: Exploratory meta-development; no new prospective labels; frozen before any specialization benchmark completes.
